## R2

- **Constructs & their role:** Reasons to use other financial institutions to borrow funds (descriptive)
- **Operationalization:** Q28 - Q29
- **Scale:** Nominal
- **Statistical test:** Descriptive statistics (frequency distribution), followed by chi-square goodness-of-fit test

## R4c

- **Scale:** Q9r - Q10r: Interval; Q11 - Q12rc: Nominal; Q31 - Q34: Interval; Q37r: Interval
- **Statistical test:** Q9r - Q10r: Independent groups t-test; Q11 - Q12rc: Chi-square test of independence; Q31 - Q34: Independent groups t-test; Q37r: Independent groups t-test

## R5

- **Scale:** Ordinal
- **Statistical test:** Descriptive statistics (frequency distribution, median, mode), followed by chi-square goodness-of-fit test

## R6

- **Constructs & their role:** Attitude toward operational effectiveness (descriptive)
- **Scale:** Q9r - Q10r: Interval; Q11 - Q12rc: Nominal; Q31 - Q34: Interval; Q37r: Interval
- **Statistical test:** Descriptive statistics, followed by: Q9r - Q10r: One group t-test; Q11 - Q12rc: Chi-square goodness-of-fit test; Q31 - Q34: Reliability analysis, then one group t-test; Q37r: One group t-test

## H1

- **Role of awareness of the regular share account:** I.V.
- **Role of the degree to which current financial services meet members' needs:** D.V.
- **Scale of Q33:** Interval
- **Statistical test:** Descriptive statistics, followed by one-way ANOVA

## H2

- **Role of member opinion on CU's rate charge:** Test variable 1
- **Role of member agreement that CU's loan rates are lower than competitors:** Test variable 2
- **Operationalization:** Q8r; Q30
- **Scale:** Interval; Interval
- **Statistical test:** Paired samples (dependent) t-test
